Card Q&A.a: This card can digivolve from [Shoutmon] with a play cost of 4 or less or a [Dorulumon] with a play of cost 4 or less for a cost of 0.
Card Q&A.q: When is digivolution possible with this card's digivolution requirements?

Effect: [When Attacking] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn. Then, by placing 1 Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] trait from this Digimon's digivolution cards under 1 of your Tamers, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less.
